Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 29

“...my limbs give way, my mouth goes dry, my body trembles, and my hair stands on end.”

Four symptoms in a single line, and every one of them involuntary. Arjuna, among the finest warriors alive, is describing what we would now recognize at once as a panic response.
